title: Freshworks Acquires AI Startup Robusta To Strengthen IT Operations Platform
script:
Nasdaq-listed SaaS giant Freshworks just bought Tel Aviv startup Robusta Dev for an undisclosed sum.
The Robusta Dev platform builds automated troubleshooting tools to fix IT incidents in production environments.
Freshworks plans to embed this automation straight into its Freshservice IT service management platform.
Inc42 Media reported the acquisition to speed up enterprise incident resolutions across customer support software.
Will automated incident resolution completely replace human help desks?
